overall_assessment: Extraction from the Steiner PDF is complete and readable: all seven course-plan parts are present in all eight controls. Defects are limited to PDF page-number lines left in the text, lost bullet glyphs/broken lines, and one offering (M-PEL2.1) whose text is a different course's plan.

findings.description: Offering M-PEL2.1 (Pedagogikk og elevkunnskap 2, emne 1) has extracted text titled and coded PEL1.4 (Pedagogikk og elevkunnskap 1, emne 4: Skolen som organisasjon). The text is another course's plan, so this offering silently carries wrong data (and probably duplicates the plan of the offering for PEL1.4). Possibly the course code is mapped to the wrong PDF split, or the PDF has no separate PEL2.1 section.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: pdf_split strategy maps the course code M-PEL2.1 to the wrong section/page range of the programme PDF (code format with a dot 'PEL2.1' versus underscore 'PEL1_4' in other codes).
findings.suggested_fix: Check the code-to-section matching in the pdf_split strategy (R/harvest_strategies.R / institution_config.R steiner entry); verify the extracted heading code equals the offering's code and give a missing/failed result rather than another course's text when no match exists. Check whether other offerings share the PEL1.4 text.

findings.description: Bare PDF page numbers (e.g. '9', '10', '11', '14', '15') appear as stand-alone lines, including in the middle of lists and sentences. This is page chrome, not plan text.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The PDF text conversion keeps running page numbers; no post_fn removes lines consisting only of digits.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a post_fn for steiner that drops lines matching ^\s*\d{1,3}\s*$ (and rejoins the split sentence/list item where a page break interrupted it).

findings.description: PDF line wrapping is kept: bullets are broken across lines, sometimes separated from their start by a blank line (page break), and in several courses the bullet glyph is lost and only leading spaces remain. List items cannot be reliably split; hyphenated words are split across lines too (e.g. 'begynner-' / 'undervisningen').
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: PDF-to-text conversion (R/extract_fulltext.R) preserves hard line wraps and page-break blank lines and drops some bullet symbols.
findings.suggested_fix: In post-processing join continuation lines (line not starting with bullet/heading and previous line not ending in sentence punctuation), remove blank lines directly following a page-number line, and rejoin hyphenated line breaks.
